items.both_sides: The span holds, but on grounds this row does not state. Onset side of the marked interior candidate: the messenger formula at Ezek.14.21 is real, and is subordinated by the conjunction that opens the verse, so it resumes the oracle rather than opening one, and the address does not change - Jerusalem and the house of Israel throughout. Close side: Ezek.14.20 does not end on a close signature at all; it ends בְצִדְקָתָ֖ם יַצִּ֥ילוּ נַפְשָֽׁם, because its utterance signature belongs to the oath standing earlier in the verse. Only 2 of the 5 utterance-bearing verses in this span, MT 14:14 and MT 14:23, end verse-finally on the signature. So neither limb of the book's condition for cutting at a messenger formula - a change of address, or a refrain close standing immediately before it - is met, the pe recorded at MT 14:20 stands as interior corroboration of the list's own rhythm, and the row's conclusion is right for reasons other than the ones it gives.
